steps: Let the original mass be N_0. The mass disintegrated is (7/8)N_0.
The remaining mass is N = N_0 - (7/8)N_0 = (1/8)N_0.
Using the radioactive decay formula: N = N_0(1/2)^n, where n is the number of half-lives.
Substitute N: (1/8)N_0 = N_0(1/2)^n, which gives (1/2)^3 = (1/2)^n, so n = 3.
The total time taken is t = n * T_{1/2} = 3 * 60 days = 180 days.
